messages:
Sam: fyi a support ticket: tenant got billed twice after a stream gc + reconnect. looks like toolcall replay is being recorded as confirmed twice. can we triage?
Priya: can you paste the short server trace?
Sam: redacted excerpt:
```
router: gc_trim session=sess-900 seq=133 reason=kvcache_evict
stream: truncate session=sess-900 truncated_tokens=26
toolcall: id=tc-900a status=ok out_tokens=20
client: reconnect session=sess-900b resume_from=131
toolcall: id=tc-900a status=ok out_tokens=20 (replay)
ledger: write confirmed tenant=acct-77 tokens=40
```
Mira: ugh. we currently treat toolcall_done as the ground truth for confirmation. in streaming that is racy if the suffix was truncated before the client saw it.
Owen: short-term mitigation: ledger dedupe by canonical_toolcall_id within a 90s window. but that risks hiding legitimate repeated toolcalls.
Priya: long-term: mark toolcall token writes provisional for streaming sessions, include a commit_hint (router-provided) and only flip to confirmed on client_commit/ack. ledger reconcile worker dedupes by canonical_commit_id.
Sam: sounds right. telemetry asks: provisional_writes_total, provisional_reconciles_total, duplicate_toolcall_hits, reconcile_latency_p95. tag by rollout_flag.
Mira: console: show a small orange "pending" badge on request details when provisional>0, and a timeline event "reconciled_at" after commit. ops wants filter for pending>0.
Owen: data model idea: provisional_ledger append-only (tenant, session, canonical_toolcall_id, commit_hint, tokens, created_at). reconciliation groups provisional rows by commit_hint and canonical_toolcall_id and emits confirmed aggregate; TTL index for orphaned rows.
Priya: SDK change: clients should emit commit_ack when they successfully received the final suffix or end-of-response. backward compatibility: if no ack arrives, provisional rows expire after TTL and are marked orphaned.
Sam: rollout: feature flag billing.provisional_tokens_v1. enable for internal tenancies + 5% hosted, 100% dedicated opt-in. canary on staging first.
Mira: ops alerts: fire if duplicate_toolcall_rate > 0.3% for 5m or reconcile_latency_p95 > 30s. also alert if provisional_table_size grows unexpectedly.
Owen: short repro steps for QA:
1) run router with low kv_ttl
2) stream ~200 tokens with a toolcall at ~130
3) force GC midstream
4) reconnect client to another router that replays the toolcall
Expect: one confirmed invoice after reconcile. Current: two confirmed.
Priya: owners: Mira (router + events), Sam (ledger schema + short-term dedupe), Owen (reconcile worker), I'll own console + SDK docs. I'll draft RFC and sequence diagrams.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary queued for branch prov-tokens/sam. targets: staging-canary-4. Will report to #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:
Sam: thanks — I'll add a short failure-mode matrix in the RFC and include the DB schema sketch.
